hints.title: Sorting by Capital Requirement
hints.text: Sort all projects by their required capital to unlock available opportunities as total capital grows.

hints.title: Greedy Profit Selection
hints.text: Among all projects affordable with current capital, always select the project providing the maximum profit.

hints.title: Two-Tier Priority Extraction
hints.text: Sort projects by required capital. At each round, move all projects affordable under current capital into a max heap of profits. Pop the highest profit project and add its profit to capital. Repeat at most k times or until no affordable projects remain.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
import heapq
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def findMaximizedCapital(self, k: int, w: int, profits: List[int], capital: List[int]) -> int:
        projects = sorted(zip(capital, profits))
        n = len(projects)
        idx = 0
        max_heap = []

        for _ in range(k):
            while idx < n and projects[idx][0] <= w:
                heapq.heappush(max_heap, -projects[idx][1])
                idx += 1
            if not max_heap:
                break
            w += -heapq.heappop(max_heap)

        return w
```

complexity.time: O(N log N + K log N)
complexity.notes: Optimal greedy choice powered by priority queue extraction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all affordable projects repeatedly takes O(K * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by required capital and storing affordable profits in a heap provides optimal greedy selection.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: A max-heap of unlocked profits dynamically maintained as capital grows.
